run_test_export_models: run the unittest suite to verify TorchScript exportability of fairseq modules
test_export_multihead_attention: test that MultiheadAttention can be scripted and saved with torch.jit.script
test_incremental_state_multihead_attenti: test incremental state set and get operations on scripted MultiheadAttention modules
test_positional_embedding: test that SinusoidalPositionalEmbedding can be scripted and saved with torch.jit.script
test_export_transformer: test that a full TransformerModel can be built, scripted, and saved via TorchScript
